scope: Targeted canonical distinctions for original-costume design; does not replace the costume_system complete355 family census.

alreadyFullCyborgOrNamedCyborg.recommendation: Do not request another generic cyborg family as if the body were wholly human. The prototype and Snake’s Revenge keep explicit source continuity qualification.

partialCyberneticOrProstheticHumans.body: Mostly biological human, anatomical right cybernetic arm and powered suit.
partialCyberneticOrProstheticHumans.recommendation: Ambiguous application of user’s except-cyborg rule; keep explicit partial-cybernetic classification. A fully artificial version would be a new original concept, not canonical equipment.

partialCyberneticOrProstheticHumans.body: Biological human, anatomical left prosthetic forearm and right forehead shrapnel/right eye patch.
partialCyberneticOrProstheticHumans.recommendation: Do not copy Raiden body. If fullcyborg concept is requested, retain Venom’s individual visual identifiers and acknowledge original design.

partialCyberneticOrProstheticHumans.body: Ghost Babel human with anatomical left arm prosthetic.
partialCyberneticOrProstheticHumans.recommendation: Not fullbody Raiden-like cyborg; new allbody version is a distinct original concept, no claim of official costume.

humansInPoweredExoskeletons.recommendation: Armor and powered apparatus do not prove surgically replaced body. Preserve distinction between organic person, worn armor and full cyborg concept.

parasiteOrNanomachineEnhancedHumans.recommendation: Biological/parasite/nanomachine enhancement is not enough to classify every member as a full mechanical cyborg. Skulls are distinct anonymous representatives; no sameperson wardrobe merge.

androidAndMechanicalNonHumans.recommendation: Already mechanical; humanoidandroid and quadrupedUG remain different body classes. No organic original body invented as canon.

animalsAndChildren: Use actual source anatomy and age from BASELINE_NATIVE_SPRITE_METADATA_V1.json and costume_system eligibility. Child bodies and animal bodies are never resized into an adult humanoid to satisfy a costume family.
surviveIdentification: Use actual origin episode, not incidental string appearances in limits. Canonical Survive humans, infected and custom Captain avatar differ from project Carter reconstruction. Existing Survive UID excludes new Survive-family request per user; exact platform/gear variants remain possible separately.
styleClassification: RenderStyle does not alone establish original game technical resolution. Existing modern interpretations of MSX/NES are native painted sprites already; their original-era reference is not proof of an existing selectable retro sprite.
